nodes.title: Model Links
widgets_values:
## Multipass Relight Workflow for Radiance:

Multipass Estimate predicts render passes from a plate with trained models: MoGe-2 for metric depth, position and normals (plus AO and curvature computed from them), Marigold IID for albedo, roughness, metallic and diffuse/specular lighting.

First run downloads about 4.9 GB (switch off download_missing_models to stop it). Turn off geometry, materials or lighting to skip a model.

Write EXR Passes saves every pass as layers of one multilayer EXR. Relight lights the estimated albedo with a point light placed in camera space (metres).

- Radiance: [Documentation](https://www.fxtdstudios.com/comfyu-radiance-docs/)
- Radiance: [GitHub](https://github.com/FXTD-Studios/radiance)

## Radiance Report Issues :
To report any issues with Radiance nodes, [go to GitHub](https://github.com/FXTD-Studios/radiance/issues)

## Model Links (for Local Users)

The models download themselves on the first run (about 4.9 GB): nothing to install.

**MoGe-2** (geometry: depth, position, normals)
- [moge_2_vitl_normal_fp16](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MoGe/resolve/main/geometry_estimation/moge_2_vitl_normal_fp16.safetensors)
**Marigold IID** (materials and lighting, folders under `models/radiance/marigold`)
- [marigold-iid-appearance-v1-1](https://huggingface.co/prs-eth/marigold-iid-appearance-v1-1), [marigold-iid-lighting-v1-1](https://huggingface.co/prs-eth/marigold-iid-lighting-v1-1)

## Model Storage Location (loaded files)

```
📂 ComfyUI/
├── 📂 models/
│   ├── 📂 geometry_estimation/
│   │   └── moge_2_vitl_normal_fp16.safetensors
│   └── 📂 radiance/
│       ├── 📂 marigold/iid-appearance-v1-1/
│       └── 📂 marigold/iid-lighting-v1-1/
```

## Report Issue

Note: Please update ComfyUI first ([guide](https://docs.comfy.org/installation/update_comfyui)) and prepare required models. Desktop/Cloud updates follow stable releases, so some nightly-supported models may not be available yet.

- Cannot run / runtime errors: [ComfyUI/issues](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI/issues)
- UI / frontend issues: [ComfyUI_frontend/issues](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI_frontend/issues)
